reason: Desktop Mode is a regular XFCE or KDE Plasma (X11) session of the host user, nested in a Xephyr window; confining it would hide the host it exists to expose.
scope: Runs Xephyr, dbus-run-session and startxfce4 or startplasma-x11 as the invoking user with no added privileges; no bwrap, flatpak, containers, namespaces or VMs.
